title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland - Restaurant

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aaaah!
We did so much!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it was really fun! I didn't think we'd get to go on so many attractions.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We didn't have to line up at all either. You truly are a PXL expert, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's because Emu and Kusanagi told me when and where it gets crowded. But I'm glad that my route worked out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'd love to hear about everyone's favorite attractions. What was yours, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmmm, I think it'd be Phenny's Sweet Dream. I liked how cute it was.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just felt so happy being immersed in Phenny's world.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too!
Same here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun riding the Phoenix Coaster.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh yeah, that's the most popular roller coaster, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It looked so scary that me and Ichika ended up passing on it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But the photo of everyone at the top turned out great. Otori and Haruka had such big smiles.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had heard they take your photo, but it was amazing how you two were able to smile like that at the peak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! It was a super exciting, wonderhoy roller coaster, after all!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was. I'd like to go on it again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, what about that other attra... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, there's a staff member carrying a cake and I swear they looked over here...

rows.Speaker: Restaurant Staff
rows.Line:
Happy birthday to you♪
Happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Restaurant Staff
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, dear Ichika♪
Happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Operation Surprise, accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You prepared all of this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's not a birthday without a cake, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu and Kusanagi told me about the shops that offer special birthday services.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone! That surprised me, but I'm so grateful...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! We got to see Ichi's biggest smile today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Restaurant Staff
rows.Line: Alright. We'll go ahead and divide up the cake.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you. Please take the biggest slice, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you can also have my strawberry, Ichika! You're the star of the day!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you.
Hehe, looks yummy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, once we're done eating, shall we make our way home? It's starting to get dark too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Time really does fly by when you're having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Actually, can I stop by one place before we head home?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If the birthday girl wishes! Although, we did check out a lot of spots today. Where did you want to go?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wanted to go get some souvenirs.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku! Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What're you all doing here? I thought you were going to a theme park today?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Unless, you just came back? You spent your birthday with your friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did. It was the best day ever! It felt like I had a year's worth of fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like everything went really well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can tell you all had a lot of fun. But don't you feel tired?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, what brings you all over to SEKAI? Was there something you needed?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, not necessarily, but... We have something for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-da! We have souvenirs for you!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is PXL's famed Phenny manju! We also bought cookies, candy and all sorts of other stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're the standard souvenirs from PXL, but they're all very good. We've got plenty to go around, so let's have them together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! Thanks, girls!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Direct your thanks to Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika was the one who suggested we get souvenirs for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had so much fun today, and... I wanted to share that with all of you somehow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're grateful for the gifts, but your timing actually couldn't be more perfect.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Perfect?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We were actually preparing a birthday celebration for you, too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But we thought you'd be tired today, so we had planned to do it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Everyone...
I wanted to surprise you, but I ended up being the one surprised.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was a lot of fun going to PXL with everyone! I know we were there to celebrate your birthday, but it became a precious memory for me too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I totally get what you mean, Kohane! It was so fun trying all the churro flavors, comparing them, and getting matching merch!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope we can go all together again. We all definitely wished the day wouldn't end.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We should all go to the nighttime events next. The parade is really pretty and I'm sure it'll be fun to go see it together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Agreed! Even if it's not someone's birthday, we should go all together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, then I suppose we should book the PXL expert's services ASAP.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! I heard you had a great time with Saki and everyone at Phoenix Wonderland! I'm happy to know that your friendship is stronger than ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! It sure was a super duper happy and special one! I'm glad everyone was all smiles at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, once again, happy birthday. I'm glad I was able to celebrate your birthday with you, Hoshino. Let's hang out again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika. Celebrating at PXL must've been wonderful! I heard how much fun you all had from Minori and Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii didn't give me many details, but I could tell she had a lot of fun from the look of her face!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the celebration doesn't stop there! Be sure to look forward to coming to school next.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... Happy birthday, Hoshino. I heard that you spent your birthday at PXL.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? She had a PXL birthday celebration?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess so. Ms. Mochizuki showed me some photos, and there were a lot of Hoshino smiling.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't realize. Happy birthday, Ichika! It must've been a dream spending your birthday at a theme park. Tell me all about it next time we meet up!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm sure she had a lot of fun. Happy birthday, Hoshino. I'm glad to hear that you had a wonderful day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Despite being Saki's impromptu idea, celebrating your birthday at PXL was pretty great.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! Ichi had so much fun too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was really funny seeing Kohane take burst shots of Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hahaha, the way she did it screamed pro, huh?
That reminds me, we should print out the photos Kohane took and put them into a scrapbook!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, let's get Miku and the others to help out. We can ask them to tell us about what fun memories they had with Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for all the birthday wishes, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really had so much fun... I think that was the most fun I've ever had at PXL.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not often I have so many people celebrating my birthday with me. It's a little embarrassing, but... It made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks to all of this, I feel like I can keep working hard. I hope you'll continue to cheer me on.
